_readme: Rules for the 'same as EN' column of the generated review workbook. A Kinyarwanda value byte-identical to its English source is not automatically a gap — 'Bimoto' and '+250 7XX XXX XXX' are supposed to be identical — but a reviewer scanning the file cannot tell which is which. These lists let the generator name the reason where it is unambiguous. Anything not matched here is marked needs-decision rather than guessed at: an honest question beats a confident wrong answer.
brand: Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay
